svg.title: Mysa client API coverage map
svg.desc: Cloud/account APIs: 52 of 88 implemented, 5 partial, 31 missing. Local/provisioning APIs: 12 of 22 implemented, 0 partial, 10 missing. Last reviewed 2026-10-12. Each tile represents one inventory row.
svg.text: Direct cloud, HomeKit and setup methods implemented by the standalone client
